actual: The one authorized qe_hmm_full_v2 five-instrument initial-migration sample dss_43485e68b2645562430a12f8e7ce1620 terminated after 2283 seconds with DATASET_RELEASE_SOURCE_MANIFEST_INVALID and zero writes. The persisted message hash uniquely resolves to source query numeric value is invalid for daily_basic 2018-08-01 through 2018-10-31 pe. Read-only production sampling found 10169 PostgreSQL NaN markers across nullable daily_basic pe, pe_ttm, pb, volume_ratio, dv_ratio and dv_ttm fields. BUG-1173 normalized only exact stk_limit repairable fields; BUG-1238 addressed unrelated writer-ledger drift. Exact PostgreSQL NaN/Infinity/-Infinity in allowlisted nullable daily_basic numeric fields should become canonical null overlay inputs with a bumped query identity, while arbitrary text, required values, other datasets and database rows remain unchanged and fail closed.
